import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    F0,w,ph,k,d,g,s,a,q,e = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    return F0*np.exp(-a*t)*np.cos(w*t+ph) - k*x - d - e*x**2 + g/v + s*t/v + q/x
